dct_description_sm: Malawi administrative level 0-3 boundaries, gazetteer, and geoservice. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-mwi); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These shapefiles are suitable for database or ArcGIS linkage to the [Malawi - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-mwi) tables.
